question: For the year 2012, which top 10 evaluation groups have the largest subplot acres when considering only the condition with the largest subplot acres within each group? Please include the evaluation group, evaluation type, condition status code, evaluation description, state code, macroplot acres, and subplot acres.
sql:
WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    p.state_code,
    c.condition_status_code,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, 1.0) * c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted) as subplot_acres,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 0.0) * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0.0)) as macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    AND c.state_code = p.state_code
    AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
  WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
    AND p.inventory_year = 2012
    AND c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, p.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT evaluation_group, evaluation_type, evaluation_description, state_code, condition_status_code, macroplot_acres, subplot_acres,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT evaluation_group, evaluation_type, condition_status_code, evaluation_description, CAST(state_code AS STRING) as state_code, macroplot_acres, subplot_acres
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10
